primary_goal: 在 SSD/HBF/NVMe 共享 NAND 家族中，把已有 MemoryPosition 偏移传入 page/RMW/program 计费，修复已知地址跨页访问被按 byte_count 单独计算的问题；不新增 DRAM/HBM 第二模型。
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

baseline.role: H29 promoted runtime report reuse plus H26 shared NAND page/RMW/plane/queue baseline

direction_switch_reason: H29 已收口运行时重复报告；按用户定向任务和台账转入 NAND 家族 geometry/address mapping，保持 SSD/HBF/NVMe 共享边界。
recent_directions: H28:预测/评估请求覆盖契约

scope.candidate: DataAccess 已知 MemoryPosition.offset_bytes 到 NAND 共享服务的页边界拆分、RMW/program 计费和 endpoint/legacy alias optional API
include: endpoint_service and communication endpoint optional offset

problem_domain_closure.root_cause: expand_access.phase discarded MemoryPosition.offset_bytes and called PhysicalService.price(kind, byte_count), so NAND service could not distinguish aligned and near-page-end requests of equal size.

surfaces.schema_validation: page_offset_bytes optional and non-negative at NAND/service boundaries
surfaces.read: known offset computes pages_touched and physical read bytes
surfaces.write: known offset computes partial-page RMW reads and program writes
surfaces.copy: READ and WRITE phases use source/target positions through shared expand_access path; generic COPY owner/dependency regression retained
surfaces.endpoint: endpoint_service and communication endpoint wrapper accept optional page_offset; no-address calls remain unknown
surfaces.legacy_alias: hbf_media_service forwards optional page_offset to shared NAND model
surfaces.unknown: None or unknown_alignment_conservative keeps explicit conservative behavior; no universal geometry invented
surfaces.regression: 83 focused storage/data-motion tests and final full suite passed

problem_domain_closure.known_limit: MemoryPosition.offset_bytes default remains 0 for the existing address object API; callers that construct MemoryPosition without an explicit offset are treated as page-zero known by the core path. Direct endpoint calls without page_offset remain address_scope=unknown.

data_roles.development: fresh storage source scan and authoritative ONFI/vendor references
data_roles.holdout: offset 0 vs 4032 controls; SSD shared NAND and endpoint controls
data_roles.final_acceptance: mechanism/resource conservation and regression only; no Native accuracy

guardrails: SSD/HBF/NVMe 共享 NAND 家族，不拆成重复模型
DRAM/HBM 保持共享家族边界
没有独立来源的 geometry 保持 unknown/parameterized
不得把机制守恒测试称为 Native 精度改善
不为 die/channel/block/erase/FTL/GC 虚构通用默认值
next_step: H30 已发布；下一轮转评估/API或正确性语义方向，除非出现新的独立存储 geometry/erase/FTL 调用链证据。
